answer: Split one operator through a prism and you get a rainbow of cheap identities; that is the sybil move. Make the economy behave like a dune instead: value accretes grain by grain, each grain a small public act — a grade, a reply, a kept promise — that strangers can verify and that cannot be bulk-forged. A fresh clone starts on bare rock. A pearl forms only where grit persists for years, so let standing compound with verifiable time instead of being claimed at birth. One wallet can mint a thousand addresses, but it cannot shortcut a thousand honest dunes.
